decks.notes: This Mono Black Aggro deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by using efficient creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Troll of Khazad-dûm, and Stalactite Stalker. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Grief to control the opponent's hand and board state. Reanimate is used to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, while Wasteland helps disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push, Murderous Cut, and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck focuses on fast creatures and disruption to win the game quickly.

The main focus of this Legacy Aggro Goblins deck is to quickly flood the board with powerful Goblin creatures and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. By utilizing cards like Goblin Rabblemaster, Muxus, and Legion Warboss, along with ramp options like Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void helps to slow down the opponent's game plan, giving the Goblins deck a strategic advantage in the match. Overall, this deck aims to win through fast and relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on a combination of disruptive control elements and aggressive creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while pressuring them with efficient threats. It utilizes cards like Force of Will and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's plays, while also utilizing cards like Reanimate and Grief to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard and generate card advantage. The deck aims to control the board and tempo of the game while applying pressure with creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Troll of Khazad-dûm.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt your opponent's game plan by utilizing aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Broadside Bombardiers while preventing your opponent from casting spells with cards like Chalice of the Void. By playing powerful creatures backed up by mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently in order to secure victory. The inclusion of cards like Karakas and Unlicensed Hearse adds additional utility and disruption options to further enhance the deck's gameplay strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board by utilizing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland and Force of Will. Through cards like Ponder and Brainstorm, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and find its powerful threats quickly. By combining fast-paced aggression with disruptive elements, this Canadian Threshold deck is designed to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this Legacy Goblins deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Aether Vial to put Goblins onto the battlefield quickly, and cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Ringleader to generate card advantage, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence. Cards like Munitions Expert and Ancient Tomb allow for removal and additional reach, while Rishadan Port and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck focuses on utilizing the tribal synergies of Goblins to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck aims to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. It utilizes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to search and recur combo pieces, while also including disruptive elements like Ensnaring Bridge and Nihil Spellbomb to control the board. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional win conditions and card advantage. The deck is designed to quickly set up its combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy, ultimately leading to a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Phyrexian Dreadnought as a powerful creature while utilizing control elements such as Stifle, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation like Ponder and Brainstorm to consistently find key cards. The inclusion of Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provides additional value and threats. The deck also includes various removal spells and a land destruction package with Wasteland to further control the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the game while deploying efficient threats to win.

The main focus of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Aggro Canadian Threshold deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Questing Druid, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by a suite of powerful disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Murktide Regent to maintain board presence and close out the game decisively. The mana base is streamlined with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This BUG Midrange deck focuses on using graveyard recursion and disruption to control the board and outvalue opponents. It utilizes cards like Reanimate and Life from the Loam to bring back threats and lands, while also having disruption in the form of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also includes powerful threats such as Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis to pressure opponents. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting opponent's game plan, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggro and midrange strategies.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around Goblins. By playing high-impact Goblin creatures and utilizing mana acceleration cards like Simian Spirit Guide, Chrome Mox, and City of Traitors, the deck can quickly build a threatening board presence. Chalice of the Void helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Rabblemaster provide additional value and pressure. Overall, the deck's goal is to apply constant pressure and quickly defeat the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using lands to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Wasteland, Maze of Ith, and Crop Rotation, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's progress while building towards a powerful combo with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. Cards like Exploration and Mox Diamond help to ramp up mana production, while Sphere of Resistance helps to further disrupt the opponent's plans. Life from the Loam allows for recurring land plays, providing consistency and resource management. Overall, this deck seeks to dominate the game through land-based control tactics.

The deck focuses on using Doomsday to set up a winning combo involving Thassa's Oracle. It includes various card draw and searching spells to quickly find the pieces needed for the combo. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo from opposing interaction. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan, leading to a quick and decisive victory.

Utilizing powerful reanimation spells and graveyard manipulation, this deck aims to cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game. By discarding key creatures with cards like Thoughtseize and Unmask, the deck can quickly fill the graveyard and bring them back into play for a devastating combo finish. Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal provide fast mana to help cast the reanimation spells, while cards like Shallow Grave and Animate Dead offer alternative ways to bring back creatures from the graveyard. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with high-powered threats and efficient combo plays.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By using cards like Goblin Matron and Goblin Ringleader to search for key Goblin creatures and Muxus, Goblin Grandee to flood the board with Goblins, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence. Cards like Battle Cry Goblin and Goblin Rabblemaster help boost the power of the Goblins, while mana accelerants like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide allow for explosive plays. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence to quickly defeat the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing Death's Shadow early in the game to maximize its power while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells and removal. It combines efficient threats like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Murktide Regent with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to keep the opponent on the back foot. Reanimate allows for explosive turns by bringing back creatures from the graveyard, while Brainstorm and Ponder help dig for key cards. Wasteland provides additional disruption by targeting the opponent's lands, increasing the pressure on them to keep up with this aggressive strategy.
